protocol.written: 2026-10-31, before any score was computed on any clip by any listener
protocol.audio: every item is decoded by ffmpeg on a pipe and goes through the Tapo camera channel (8 kHz G.711 A-law and back, parenting_agent.hearing.from_file camera_channel=True), then scored the way the Ear scores: 2 s windows every 1 s, and an item fires a label when any window reaches that label's threshold
protocol.truth: an item's label from its source. hearing-set labels cough, speech and negative are no label at all, so any label they fire is a false alarm. Every Donate-a-Cry item is a cry
protocol.metrics: per label: hits (items of that label that fire it), misses, false alarms (items of any other truth that fire it). Cry first, it drives the night feed awake signal

listeners.before: PANNs CNN14 as it runs today: hearing.GROUPS and hearing.THRESHOLDS unchanged, not tuned again
listeners.meta: facebook/pe-a-frame-small (Perception Encoder Audio Frame, Apache 2.0), zero shot: per label the frame logits against the prompts below. Tune chooses on the tune set only, per label: the score (sigmoid of the best prompt, or the best prompt's logit minus the best background prompt's logit) and the threshold
listeners.signal: plain signal processing for cry only, no learned model: loudness, voiced share and pitch in the infant cry band (250 to 600 Hz), harmonic strength, longest voiced run. Thresholds on a fixed grid, chosen on the tune set only

protocol.tuning_rule: per label, maximize hits minus 3 x false alarms on the tune set. Ties go to the higher threshold. The held-out set is scored once, after every choice is written to tune.json
protocol.winner_rule: the runtime listener for a label is the Meta model when its held-out cry hits are at least those of the signal listener with no more false alarms. Otherwise the signal listener hears cries and the Meta model the other labels, or the signal listener alone if the Meta model fails everywhere
